claim: Team parent context is schema and size checked before creation; parent snapshots and eligible shared facts use cancellation-aware hash-verified CAS reads on blocking workers. Missing, corrupted, malformed, or oversized context fails closed. Parent snapshots are retained as a bounded prefix from one full-file hash scan; shared-fact inline content remains byte bounded.
limits: No Cargo compilation or Rust tests were run.
Parent snapshots are capped at 256 KiB; shared facts inline at 2.4 KiB each and 8 KiB total.
Parent snapshot content is retained as one bounded prefix while the full file is hash-verified in a single scan; no runtime latency, disk-read, or token measurements were collected.
regression_source: Corrupted parent snapshot blocks worker context assembly.
